---
title: "7: Court Curbing, Backlash and Backsliding"
---

What is the relationship between courts, legislatures and executives, and what happens when politicians decide to push back against courts? This week we look at the politics of court curbing and democratic backsliding, including how courts anticipate and adapt to threats such as legislative override, court-packing and jurisdiction-stripping.
